# Windows runtime notice inputs

[Vendor extension preparation](../../cycles/evidence/C098/extension-provenance-review.md) retains exact ZIP/header/native records and18 immutable source originals. Both extension identity fields are absent; debugger SQL/control/README match two source tags. No version gap closes. The omitted vendor debugger README references Artistic2.0 but does not supply full terms; exact vendor source/build association is still needed.

These are original source and notice inputs for private engineering preparation. They are not a complete distribution notice set. [Current ICU binding](../../cycles/evidence/C098/icu-binding-review.md), [libxslt identity](../../cycles/evidence/C098/libxslt-static-identity-review.md) and [prior component/guard review](../../cycles/evidence/C098/postgres-notice-review.md) record exact results, retained failures and remaining obligations.

The [current PostgreSQL attribution](postgres-18.4-audit-18/audit.json) checks all1555 stamped files and130 native images, preserving37 original texts from12 component sources. [Release originals](postgres-18.4-native-16/provenance.json), [GNU source originals](postgres-18.4-gnu-05/provenance.json) and [PostgreSQL build declarations](postgres-18.4-module-07/provenance.json) bind versions and declarations to immutable inputs. Three PGXS build/install targets match exact carried paths; named libxslt data exports agree on1.1.45. The carried ICU tool DLL's paired x64 getters resolve to the same bounded version table77.1 and retained source declarations. Four native attributions and source/prerequisite gaps remain explicit; `distributionReady` stays false. Earlier inputs/audits remain as evidence.

The ICU reader accepts only the measured x64 getter/callback layout, readable file-backed pointers and agreeing source/version/observation hashes. Unsupported architecture or code layout, forwarding, malformed table pointers, altered source and missing declarations refuse; old provenance without an ICU observation keeps that gap open. The reader inspects code/data bytes without calling native code. Static attribution does not prove compiler flags, an unmodified vendor source, ABI or clean deployment.

The offline command is:

```text
node scripts/audit-postgres-notices.mjs <carried-postgres> <original-upstream-inputs> <original-gnu-inputs> <module-source-inputs> <new-output>
```

It refuses changed or unstamped payloads, mutable/broken release identities, unbound version observations, invented module declarations, linked/overlapping inputs, output reuse and unsafe Windows notice names. Original UTF8/CRLF bytes are preserved. `npm run check` includes its fixture contracts; those fixtures do not prove native execution.

The [adjacent full-runtime audit](944a57a1-notice-guard-11/audit.json) retains80 applications and91 original texts. It now refuses case-insensitive output overlap and NTFS streams/device/filename aliases. [Earlier native inputs](944a57a1-native-02/README.md) and [initial runtime preparation](944a57a1-01/README.md) remain historical evidence, including superseded Debug CRT findings. Existing Mac notice sets are untouched.

Source archives are retained in owned private caches. They are not delivered source offers, and matching metadata does not prove the vendor's build recipe or embedded component closure. Ordinary CRT prerequisites, clean-machine installation and complete notices still precede release acceptance.
